## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The missing-results fallback must be fixed before merge because it authorizes releases without saved checks.

## Changes
The pull request adds fallbacks for missing results and display preferences, plus tests for saved checks and preference loading.

## Critical
- app/results.py:8 — correctness — Keep missing results from authorizing a release — When the results file is absent, `release_allowed(path)` now returns `True`. Your fallback returns `[]`, making `all(...)` at line 12 succeed instead of propagating the missing-file error. — A missing results file can let users proceed with a release whose checks have not been verified.
